verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has a dedicated versioning page stating that a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. Versioned endpoints are visible in the reference (e.g. v2 case audit trail, v3 transaction process). However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy: no notice periods, sunset timelines or support windows for older versions. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy with notice periods and sunset timelines, version-support guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.
